summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of TaxPilot AI. Backend: 16 pytest cases across auth (signup/login/me/duplicate), demo seed, documents (list/get/404), LLM extraction (claude-sonnet-5 + gpt-5.4), review queue (list/acknowledge/skip), return pipeline status, and deductions — 16/16 PASSED. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): onboarding → signup → dashboard flow works, demo seed creates 4 docs + 2 review items, Document Vault filter chips render and show 4 docs, document detail loads with Claude/GPT model chips, review queue acknowledge reduces card count (2→1), profile shows compliance rows + signout, demo 4-step flow reaches finish button, upload screen renders with camera/photos/files pickers. Google Auth button exists on login screen (not clicked to avoid OAuth redirect).

issues: Deprecation warnings from React Native Web: 'Image style.resizeMode' and 'props.pointerEvents' — non-blocking but should be migrated to newer APIs

action_items: OPTIONAL: Address React Native Web deprecation warnings for Image.resizeMode (move to props) and pointerEvents (move to style)
OPTIONAL: Dashboard pipeline may show stale 'Step 1 of 7' after demo seed until user navigates back — consider refetching /api/return/status on tab focus
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 641 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, documents, review, pipeline) for maintainability
storage_key cached at module level — good, includes 503 refresh, but not thread-safe across workers (acceptable for now)
All backend endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id field, use Pydantic validation, and return proper HTTP codes
seed_data_creation: Test user created per-run with unique email (TEST_taxpilot_<uuid>@example.com). /api/demo/seed used to populate 4 sample documents + 2 review items per test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_taxpilot_api.py — must be run with `-o addopts=''` since /app/backend/pytest.ini enables xdist parallel which causes cross-worker fixture isolation issues (already handled by making test_login_success depend on the `auth` fixture). Frontend uses testID props verified across all screens. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is set. No mocked APIs.
